[[File:Hutt_Dependencies.jpg|150px|thumb|The Hutt Dependencies.]]
The '''Hutt dependencies''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the region was recognized by [[137 ABY]] when it included such [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] as the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]], [[Daluuj system/Legends|Daluuj system]], and [[Opoku system]].
